target.title: Index rebuild preserves canonical knowledge
target.rationale: The index is a derived cache. Canonical knowledge stays in Vault Markdown and attachments, so deleting and rebuilding SQLite cannot erase that knowledge.

distractors.title: Index schema rebuild
distractors.rationale: Rebuild the index after a schema migration to materialize new columns; this addresses schema compatibility.

distractors.title: Index tokenizer rebuild
distractors.rationale: Rebuild FTS after a tokenizer change so search terms use the new token boundaries.

distractors.title: Index corruption recovery
distractors.rationale: Rebuild a damaged index from the Vault files to restore search availability.

distractors.title: Index performance rebuild
distractors.rationale: Rebuild fragmented index tables to improve local query performance.

distractors.title: Index version rebuild
distractors.rationale: Rebuild an old index revision when the reader requires a newer layout.

target.title: Note hash prevents write conflict
target.rationale: Recheck the note hash immediately before applying a typed write. If an external edit changed the note, report a conflict instead of overwriting the user's bytes.

distractors.title: Note hash provenance
distractors.rationale: Record a note hash to identify the exact source bytes behind a citation; this is provenance, not concurrent edit protection.

distractors.title: Note hash deduplication
distractors.rationale: Compare note hashes to skip redundant indexing of unchanged content.

distractors.title: Note hash cache invalidation
distractors.rationale: Use a changed note hash to invalidate derived search chunks.

distractors.title: Note hash audit trail
distractors.rationale: Store the prewrite note hash in a transaction journal to support recovery inspection.

distractors.title: Note hash snapshot identity
distractors.rationale: Name a snapshot by its note hash so recovery can select the recorded version.

basis: AGENTS.md INV-009 and Safe write flow; 13_ADR ADR-056

decision_context: Web Clipper custom extension browser capture

target.title: Web Clipper replaces custom extension for basic capture
target.rationale: Use the official Obsidian Web Clipper for baseline browser capture. A custom extension needs evidence of bidirectional capabilities before adding another browser surface.

distractors.title: Web Clipper Interpreter optional
distractors.rationale: Keep deterministic Web Clipper templates usable without the Interpreter; this controls model dependency.

distractors.title: Web Clipper field mapping
distractors.rationale: Map captured page metadata into a lightweight Inbox artifact; semantic entity creation remains in Core.

distractors.title: Web Clipper Inbox destination
distractors.rationale: Send browser captures to the Inbox Web folder for later processing.

distractors.title: Web Clipper raw marker
distractors.rationale: Mark raw browser captures so indexing can classify them independently of their path.

distractors.title: Web Clipper mobile compatibility
distractors.rationale: Keep the capture template compatible with the supported browser and Obsidian surfaces.
